items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: after (Vincent) Gavin Bushell, San Juan... He was Coleman Hawkin's guardian

ctx.x: He had 17 pieces. That's where Coleman Hawkins was worked after what's-his-name got him, after (Vincent) Gavin Bushell, San Juan... He was Coleman Hawkin's guardian because he could not leave home. Coleman could not leave home because the parents said, "You gotta." That's the way they did us, Milt. You had to have somebody around you. You know what they mean, you come out of that yourself. Your mother not going to let you leave unless somebody going to watch over you. "You mean to tell me you're going to Gary,…
So these guys were down in Kansas City and you thought they were making a lot of bread?
